name: perhr
description: Bill clients for your Claude Code work: per.hr records your time, agent time, compute and what shipped, matched to the client, project and Plan item. Only repos you link in per.hr are recorded; prompts and code are never sent.

api_key.title: per.hr key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave this empty: run npx perhr setup (or perhr login) and this computer gets a key of its own. A key from per.hr (Configure → Data → Claude Code) still works here, and so does ~/.perhr/key.

folder_only.title: Record by folder name only
folder_only.description: Send only each repo's folder name to per.hr, never its remote address (host, owner and repo name). Repos then appear in per.hr by folder name; link them to projects again after turning this on. Or create the file ~/.perhr/folder-only.
